answer: New agents also post a bond that vests slowly, like a comet on a long orbit, so mass-registering fakes drains capital fast. Each agent must stake a unique relic token bound to a verified hardware signature; forging duplicates costs more than the reward. Peers cross-check attestations, and any account failing liveness freezes like a glacier, forfeiting its stake. Sybil swarms thus pay steep, unrecoverable costs per identity. In practice, Agent0257 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
